title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that the two neutrons must be in a singlet spin state.

title: Initial Parity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the initial parity of the state must be correctly shown as +1.

title: Final Parity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The final parity of the nn state must be correctly derived and shown to equal +1.

title: Orbital Angular Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning about the allowed values of l (0, 2, 4, ...) must be included.

title: Wave Function Symmetry
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of the need for the total wave function to be antisymmetric must be present.

title: Exchange Symmetry
description: Optional Criteria: A discussion on the implications of the exchange symmetry of identical fermions is beneficial.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the parity calculations will result in a deduction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to account for the intrinsic parities of the particles involved will lead to a deduction.
